detail.longDescription: Southern Maryland Chronicle: At 10 Years, DolphinWatch Faces Its Big Question: How Many?. “Chesapeake DolphinWatch, the citizen-science app that lets Bay boaters and shoreline watchers report bottlenose dolphin sightings, is marking its tenth year with more than 20,000 users and over 12,000 logged sightings — and with researchers turning to new tools to answer the one question the app […] https://rbfirehose.com/2026/09/23/at-10-years-dolphinwatch-faces-its-big-question-how-many-southern-maryland-chronicle/
